Booking & Payment

Booking & Payment

Payments for your Captivating India holiday can be made either by bank transfer or by credit/debit card. Prices are quoted in Indian Rupees (INR). We are happy to receive payment in any internationally acceptable currency and the holiday price will be converted using the exchange rate stipulated by the Reserve Bank of India on the date the payment is made.

If you choose to transfer money directly to our account, please ensure that any bank charges are borne by you. We will credit the exact amount that we receive in our account; any shortfall or excess will be adjusted against your client account and collected or refunded as required. An additional surcharge may be applied for payment by credit card.

Booking terms & cancellation policy

A 25% advance is normally required to process your booking, with the balance payable at least 45 days prior to travel (60 days during peak periods). In some peak‑season cases a higher deposit or full advance may be required; we will advise this at the time of booking.

Please note this is an advance payment only and not a refundable deposit. Refunds are processed based on our cancellation policy and the type of holiday booked. For flights, trains and pre‑booked safaris, tickets are often non‑refundable.

Cancellation charges (guideline)

  • More than 60 days prior to travel: no retention other than minimal administration charges.
  • 60–45 days prior to start of the holiday: approximately 25% of the tour cost.
  • 45 days to one month prior: approximately 50% of the tour cost.
  • One month or less prior: up to 100% of the tour cost.

In the unlikely event that you need to cancel, we will always try our best to recover as much as possible from hotels and service providers and pass any refunds back to you after deducting administration charges.

If you decide to postpone your trip after confirmation and it falls within the cancellation period, we will endeavour to credit the amount paid against a future trip, subject to using the same itinerary and hotels and their individual policies.

For detailed booking and payment information tailored to your itinerary, our team will be happy to advise you. Please contact us at info@captivatingindia.co.uk.
